description: For one of your licensed sectors: public consultations and other regulatory deadlines falling due in the next `days`, then the acts published in the current window (Diário Oficial, the sector regulator, Câmara/Senado), each with its lifecycle stage and a link to the act. Use for 'which regulatory deadlines are coming up in energy'. Deterministic: computed from official datasets, no model in the loop.

days.description: Optional. Deadline horizon in days, default 90.

sector.description: Sector: energy, health, pharmaceutical, telecom, logistics, last_mile, agro, retail, mining or aviation (Portuguese names work too).

name: regulatory_events
title: Regulatory acts and deadlines for a sector
